map.输入 EBIT 与折旧摊销，求 EBITDA。: Compute EBITDA by adding depreciation and amortization back to EBIT to assess operating cash generation.
map.跨资本结构与折旧政策不同的企业对比，EBITDA 剔除这些差异。: For comparing companies with different capital structures and depreciation policies, EBITDA removes those differences.
map.杠杆收购(LBO)与估值中，用 EV/EBITDA 衡量买入价格相对盈利。: In leveraged buyouts (LBO) and valuation, EV/EBITDA measures the purchase price relative to earnings.
map.评估企业付息前、税前、折旧摊销前的现金流生成能力。: Assesses cash generation before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation.
map.某公司 EBIT 200 万元，当年折旧 50 万元、摊销 30 万元，EBIT: A company has EBIT of 200 (10k CNY), depreciation of 50 (10k CNY) and amortisation of 30 (10k CNY), so EBITDA = 200+50+30 = 280 (10k CNY), reflecting operating earnings before non-cash costs.
map.不能。它未扣除资本性支出、营运资本变动与税费，会高估真实可自由支配现金；应结合自: No. It does not deduct capital expenditure, changes in working capital or taxes, so it overstates true free cash; read it together with free cash flow.
map.为什么资本市场常用 EBITDA 倍数？: Why is the EBITDA multiple so common in capital markets?
map.它剔除了折旧政策、资本结构与税率差异，便于跨公司横向比较；但重资产行业折旧大，易: It strips out differences in depreciation policy, capital structure and tax rates, making cross-company comparison easier; but asset-heavy industries have large depreciation, so it can be abused to hide true earnings quality.
